sources.title: merileijona/quantumgpt-354m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: QuantumGPT-354M is a GPT-style language model (354.1M parameters) trained from scratch on quantum circuit description → OpenQASM 2.0 pairs. It is the third model in the QuantumGPT scaling series, scaling model depth and width while holding training data constant at 21,208 samples. Key finding ...

sources.title: merileijona/quantumgpt-354m-finetuned · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The 354M sibling of QuantumGPT-124M-v3: GPT-2 medium architecture (24 layers, 16 heads, 1024 embd, natively 512-token context) fine-tuned with the same format-anchor recipe that produced the v3 champion.
